exact_statement: For g(X,Y)=(-1)^(XY) under independent Bernoulli(p), Bernoulli(q), 0<p,q<1, with A={X}, the complete strict-sign regions and zero set of F=J_A-M_A are those in PROOF.md, as follows. Put psi(x)=h2(sin^2 x), theta=arcsin(sqrt(p)), alpha=atan(sqrt(p/(1-p))*(1-2q)), w=1-4pq(1-q). Then F=w[psi(theta)-psi(alpha)-psi(theta-alpha)]. There is a unique s_* in (0,pi/4) with 2psi(s_*/2)=psi(s_*); p_*=sin^2(s_*) lies strictly between 7634531/20971520 and 152690623/419430400. For G_s(x)=psi(x)+psi(s-x)-psi(s), 0<x<s<pi/2: if s>=pi/4, G_s>0; if s<s_*, G_s<0; if s=s_*, G_s<0 except G_s(s/2)=0; if s_*<s<pi/4, it has exactly two simple zeros a(s),s-a(s), with 0<a(s)<s/2, is positive between them, and negative outside. For q<1/2, F=-w G_theta(alpha). For q>1/2,p<=1/2, F<0. For q>1/2,p>1/2, let q0=1/(2p), s=pi/2-theta, b=-alpha: F=-w G_s(b) for q<q0, F=0 at q=q0, and F<0 for q>q0. Also F(p,1/2)=0. The numbers of distinct interior q zeros are respectively 1,2,3,1,4,3,2 on p in (0,p_*), {p_*}, (p_*,1/2), {1/2}, (1/2,1-p_*), {1-p_*}, (1-p_*,1). On the continuous outer edges F(0,q)=F(1,q)=F(p,0)=0 and F(p,1)=-h2(4p(1-p)). Both actual singleton choices {X} and {Y} violate J_A<=M_A for every real 0<p,q<p_*.
hypotheses: M_A is conditional spectral entropy and J_A actual physical-child mixture mutual information
Shannon entropy in bits; outer edges mean continuous limits

supersedes.reason: Completes the same open packet from restricted rectangles to the full continuum sign map; the old restricted theorem remains valid.

refutes: A tax-free biased J_A<=M_A theorem after existential singleton choice, even on all two-bit AND biases.
